summary: Eagle Point Trinity Senior Secured Lending Company filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 29,669.53 common shares at an implied price of about $10.21 per share (aggregate proceeds $303,062.50), consistent with NAV. The issuance was exempt under Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D, and/or Regulation S. No tender, acquisition, or special situation is involved—this is a routine equity capital raise. There is no evidence of a broader special-situation event such as a strategic review, restructuring, or activism. The filing is merely a current report for unregistered sales disclosure and NAV update.
